(i) The diagram below shows the graphs of $y=e^x$ and $y=x^4$.

(a) Show that the iteration formula $x_{n+1}=4\ln x_n$ can be used to estimate the $x$-coordinate of the point of intersection near $x=8$, and that the iteration formula $x_{n+1}=e^{x_n/4}$ can be used to estimate the $x$-coordinate of the point of intersection near $x=1$.
Use one of these formulae with $x_0=8$ or $x_0=1$, respectively, to find the $x$-coordinate of one point of intersection correct to three decimal places. [8 marks]
